csv_project_name: Consultant Services for Unified Development Ordinance
csv_scope_of_work: The City of Clemson, South Carolina, is seeking proposals from qualified professional planning and multidisciplinary consulting firms to undertake the creation of a Unified Development Ordinance (UDO). The City recently completed and adopted its new Comprehensive Plan. Rather than restarting the planning conversation, this project is intended to serve as a direct implementation step.

title: Consultant Services for Unified Development Ordinance
short_description: Consulting services to prepare a unified development ordinance implementing Clemson’s comprehensive plan.
project_scope: Preparation of a Unified Development Ordinance (UDO) for the City of Clemson as a direct implementation step following adoption of the new Comprehensive Plan. The scope is focused on land use planning, master planning, and urban planning/design; no specific building, bridge, span, or gross floor area is stated.
services: Professional planning and multidisciplinary consulting services for land use planning, planning/master planning, urban studies, and urban planning/design related to drafting the UDO.
